notes.subject: מרזח
notes.rationale: Daɲɛ in bɛ Tanaki kɔnɔ yɔrɔ fila dɔrɔn de (Amosi 6:7, Jeremiya 16:5) — a kɔrɔ ye 'bɛɛ-bɛɛ don' (revel/mourning-feast) ye

notes.subject: סרוחים
notes.rationale: Root סרח 'to exceed' — 'minnu ye u yɛrɛ wili' (KJV 'stretched themselves') walima 'minnu balen don' (to excess)

notes.subject: יגלו/גלים
notes.rationale: Cogo kelen na min bɛ fɔ jagoya (גלה) — 'u bɛna jagoya' ni 'jagokɛ' — bɛɛ bɔ cogo kelen na, Bamanankan na o tɛ jira

translation: O nafa na, sisan <sira la>, jagokɛ fɔlɔw bɛ tugu o fɔlɔ, ni minnu ye u yɛrɛ wili-wili, u ka marzahu-don bɛna bɔ ⟨a yɛrɛ la⟩.
